measurement_scope.logical: ResourceLedger live/peak RAM charges, including reservations and estimates
measurement_scope.cpp_heap: ordinary operator new requested bytes; allocator headers, usable size and native malloc excluded
measurement_scope.validation: matched temporary source copies add entry/exit callbacks around production ValidateReferences
measurement_scope.rss: whole process maximum; includes fixture creation and profiler headers; not a validation-only RSS delta

limitations: One instrumented run per revision/distribution; no timing qualification.
Sparse fixture references do not reproduce the owner manifest distribution.
Original harness preceded noinline attributes on replacement allocation functions; original observations are retained.
Fixture creation and recovery share a process and warm filesystem metadata; this is not a cold OS-cache benchmark.
